/*LGVATT00031.retrievePregnantEmp*/ SELECT pg.employee_no AS employee_no ,em.full_name_local AS employee_name ,em.org_name_local AS emp_org_name ,to_char(pg.effective_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_date ,to_char(pg.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date ,pg.ot_allow_flag AS ot_allow_flag ,pg.emp_category_code AS emp_category_code ,to_char(pg.week25_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS week25_date ,pg.remark AS remark ,to_char(pg.creation_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS creation_date FROM tb_att_pregnant_emp_m pg ,emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = pg.employee_no AND pg.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}
ORDER BY pg.employee_no, pg.effective_start_date

/*LGVATT00031.excelDownData*/ INSERT INTO xxlge_export_info (SESSION_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARACTER_SET_NAME ,ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9) SELECT AI.* FROM ( SELECT #{sessionId} ,#{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE ,1 ,'KO16KSC5601' ,'Employee No' AS employee_no ,'Employee Name' AS employee_name ,'Organization' AS emp_org_name ,'Start Date' AS effective_start_date ,'End Date' AS effective_end_date ,'OT Allowed (Y/N)' AS ot_allow_flag ,'Category' AS emp_category_code ,'Week 25 Date' AS week25_date ,'Remark' AS remark FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT #{sessionId} ,#{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE ,2 ,'KO16KSC5601' ,pg.employee_no ,em.full_name_local ,em.org_name_local ,to_char(pg.effective_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,to_char(pg.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,pg.ot_allow_flag ,DECODE(pg.emp_category_code, 'PREGNANT', 'Pregnant', 'CHILD_CARE', 'Raising Young Child', pg.emp_category_code) ,to_char(pg.week25_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,pg.remark FROM tb_att_pregnant_emp_m pg ,emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = pg.employee_no AND pg.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}
) AI
mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT00031.retrieveEmployeeExists*/ COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = #{employeeNo}
mapper.update: /*LGVATT00031.mergePregnantEmp*/ MERGE INTO tb_att_pregnant_emp_m a USING dual b ON ( a.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} AND a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND a.effective_start_date = to_date(#{effectiveStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET effective_end_date = to_date(#{effectiveEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,ot_allow_flag = NVL(#{otAllowFlag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N') ,emp_category_code = NVL(#{empCategoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PREGNANT') ,week25_date = to_date(#{week25Date, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,remark = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} ,last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (subsidiary_code ,employee_no ,effective_start_date ,effective_end_date ,ot_allow_flag ,emp_category_code ,week25_date ,remark ,creation_user_id ,creation_date ,last_update_user_id ,last_update_date) VALUES (#{subsidiaryCode} ,#{employeeNo} ,to_date(#{effectiveStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,to_date(#{effectiveEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,NVL(#{otAllowFlag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N') ,NVL(#{empCategoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PREGNANT') ,to_date(#{week25Date, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,#{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,#{applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE ,#{applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT00031.retrieveOverlapPeriod*/ a.employee_no AS employee_no ,to_char(a.effective_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_date ,to_char(a.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date FROM tb_att_pregnant_emp_m a ,tb_att_pregnant_emp_m b WHERE a.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} AND a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND b.subsidiary_code = a.subsidiary_code AND b.employee_no = a.employee_no AND b.effective_start_date <> a.effective_start_date AND a.effective_start_date <= NVL(b.effective_end_date, to_date('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) /* 종료일 없음 = 무기한 */ AND b.effective_start_date <= NVL(a.effective_end_date, to_date('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.sql: SELECT li.seq_no ,trim(li.attribute1) AS employee_no ,trim(li.attribute4) AS start_str ,trim(li.attribute5) AS end_str ,NVL(upper(trim(li.attribute6)), 'N') AS ot_allow_flag ,CASE WHEN trim(li.attribute7) IS NULL THEN 'PREGNANT' WHEN upper(trim(li.attribute7)) IN ('PREGNANT') THEN 'PREGNANT' WHEN upper(trim(li.attribute7)) IN ('CHILD_CARE', 'RAISING YOUNG CHILD') THEN 'CHILD_CARE' ELSE upper(trim(li.attribute7)) END AS emp_category_code ,trim(li.attribute8) AS week25_str ,trim(li.attribute9) AS remark FROM lgcom_import_n li WHERE li.session_id = #{sessionId} AND li.seq_no > 1 AND trim(li.attribute1) IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT00031.retrieveUploadErrorList*/ x.seq_no ,x.employee_no ,x.error_msg FROM (SELECT u.seq_no ,u.employee_no ,CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = u.employee_no) THEN 'Employee No does not exist' WHEN u.start_str IS NULL OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(u.start_str, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$') THEN 'Start Date must be DD/MM/YYYY' WHEN u.end_str IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(u.end_str, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$') THEN 'End Date must be DD/MM/YYYY' WHEN u.end_str IS NOT NULL AND to_date(u.end_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY') < to_date(u.start_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY') THEN 'End Date is earlier than Start Date' WHEN u.ot_allow_flag NOT IN ('Y', 'N') THEN 'OT Allowed must be Y or N' WHEN u.emp_category_code NOT IN ('PREGNANT', 'CHILD_CARE') THEN 'Category must be Pregnant(PREGNANT) or Raising Young Child(CHILD_CARE)' WHEN u.emp_category_code = 'PREGNANT' AND u.week25_str IS NULL THEN 'Week 25 Date is required for Pregnant' WHEN u.emp_category_code = 'PREGNANT' AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(u.week25_str, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$') THEN 'Week 25 Date must be DD/MM/YYYY' WHEN u.emp_category_code = 'PREGNANT' AND to_date(u.week25_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY') NOT BETWEEN to_date(u.start_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND NVL(to_date(u.end_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), to_date('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) THEN 'Week 25 Date must be between Start Date and End Date' ELSE NULL END AS error_msg FROM () u) x WHERE x.error_msg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.seq_no
mapper.update: /*LGVATT00031.mergeUploadPregnantEmp*/ MERGE INTO tb_att_pregnant_emp_m a USING (SELECT u.employee_no ,to_date(u.start_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_date ,to_date(u.end_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date ,u.ot_allow_flag ,u.emp_category_code ,CASE WHEN u.emp_category_code = 'PREGNANT' THEN to_date(u.week25_str, 'DD/MM/YYYY') END AS week25_date ,u.remark FROM () u) b ON ( a.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} AND a.employee_no = b.employee_no AND a.effective_start_date = b.effective_start_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.effective_end_date = b.effective_end_date ,a.ot_allow_flag = b.ot_allow_flag ,a.emp_category_code = b.emp_category_code ,a.week25_date = b.week25_date ,a.remark = b.remark ,a.last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} ,a.last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (subsidiary_code, employee_no, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, ot_allow_flag, emp_category_code, week25_date, remark ,creation_user_id, creation_date, last_update_user_id, last_update_date) VALUES (#{subsidiaryCode}, b.employee_no, b.effective_start_date, b.effective_end_date, b.ot_allow_flag, b.emp_category_code, b.week25_date, b.remark ,#{applicationUserId}, SYSDATE, #{applicationUserId}, SYSDATE)
